tools.name: ried_taxi_get_quote
tools.description: Returns RIED.TAXI's current price for one journey, calculated by the ried.taxi backend (the only valid price source). Read-only: it never books or reserves anything. Returns quote_id (valid 30 min), status priced | manual_quote_required | not_offered, and the resolved pickup/destination - show those

tools.name: ried_taxi_check_availability
tools.description: Checks RIED.TAXI's real calendar (bookings, the owner's own calendar and other customers' temporary holds). One car, one driver: availability depends on the whole day including driving to the pickup and back, not only the minute. Read-only; a free result is NOT a reservation. Returns alternatives wh

tools.name: ried_taxi_hold_booking
tools.description: Temporarily reserves the quoted date for THIS customer for 15 minutes so nobody else (website or another assistant) can take it while the customer confirms. Expires automatically. Not a booking. Call after availability is confirmed and the customer wants to proceed.

tools.name: ried_taxi_create_booking
tools.description: Creates a REAL, CONFIRMED booking in RIED.TAXI's booking system and blocks the day. Only call after the customer has seen the complete trip and price and explicitly said yes. tools.name: ried_taxi_get_booking
tools.description: Returns status, pickup time, addresses, price and flight of ONE booking. Requires the booking reference and the access code the customer received when booking. Read-only.

tools.name: ried_taxi_update_booking
tools.description: Changes a booking. Always call first with mode='preview' and show the result to the customer; then call with mode='apply', customer_confirmed=true and an idempotency_key. Same-day time changes, flight number, passengers (max 5), notes and new addresses with the same price apply immediately; a new da

tools.name: ried_taxi_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancels a booking, free of charge, any time before the pickup. Requires reference, access code, customer_confirmed=true after the customer explicitly confirmed, and an idempotency_key. Cannot be undone.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "ried_taxi_update_booking" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
